name: Saskatchewan
description: The southern half is Interior Plains (grassland and parkland, intensively farmed); the northern half is Canadian Shield and boreal forest with thousands of lakes. Relief is low except for the Cypress Hills and river valleys (South and North Saskatchewan, Qu'Appelle).
